entities.summary: Lucien Leopold Joseph Jottrand was a Walloon-Belgian lawyer, politician, progressive flamingant and Pan-Netherlander. He was a member of the National Congress of Belgium shortly after the de facto independence of Belgium and held a unique position in the young Flemish Movement.
